title: The Child and Zoo
statementMd:
Of course our child likes walking in a zoo. The zoo has $*n*$ areas, that are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. The $*i*$-th area contains $*a*_{*i*}$ animals in it. Also there are $*m*$ roads in the zoo, and each road connects two distinct areas. Naturally the zoo is connected, so you can reach any area of the zoo from any other area using the roads.

Our child is very smart. Imagine the child want to go from area $*p*$ to area $*q*$. Firstly he considers all the simple routes from $*p*$ to $*q*$. For each route the child writes down the number, that is equal to the minimum number of animals among the route areas. Let's denote the largest of the written numbers as $*f*(*p*, *q*)$. Finally, the child chooses one of the routes for which he writes down the value $*f*(*p*, *q*)$.

After the child has visited the zoo, he thinks about the question: what is the average value of $*f*(*p*, *q*)$ for all pairs $*p*, *q*$ $(*p* ≠ *q*)$? Can you answer his question?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$; $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$). The second line contains $*n*$ integers: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$). Then follow $*m*$ lines, each line contains two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$; $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}$), denoting the road between areas $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$.

All roads are bidirectional, each pair of areas is connected by at most one road.

## Output

Output a real number — the value of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/711ce638ce395f1d97748fe15c3c19ca75608d12.png).

The answer will be considered correct if its relative or absolute error doesn't exceed $10^{ - 4}$.

## Note

Consider the first sample. There are $12$ possible situations:

- $*p* = 1, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$.
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$.
- $*p* = 4, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 30$.
- $*p* = 1, *q* = 2, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$.
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 4, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$.
- $*p* = 4, *q* = 1, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$.

Another $6$ cases are symmetrical to the above. The average is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d9c496a5e88de440a3524fc0ff31a1eb3c1319f.png).

Consider the second sample. There are $6$ possible situations:

- $*p* = 1, *q* = 2, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$.
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$.
- $*p* = 1, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$.

Another $3$ cases are symmetrical to the above. The average is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb2ccbdfc02919359d0cc1f9a87c77b936f33464.png).
statementZhMd:
当然，孩子喜欢在动物园里散步。动物园有 $*n*$ 个区域，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。第 $*i*$ 个区域中有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 只动物。此外，动物园中还有 $*m*$ 条道路，每条道路连接两个不同的区域。显然，动物园是连通的，因此可以通过道路从任意一个区域到达另一个区域。

我们的孩子非常聪明。假设孩子想从区域 $*p*$ 前往区域 $*q*$。首先，他会考虑所有从 $*p*$ 到 $*q*$ 的简单路径。对于每条路径，孩子都会记下一个数，它等于路径上各区域中动物数量的最小值。我们将这些记录下来的数中的最大值记为 $*f*(*p*, *q*)$。最后，孩子会选择一条使他记录下的数等于 $*f*(*p*, *q*)$ 的路径。

参观完动物园后，孩子思考这样一个问题：对于所有满足 $*p* ≠ *q*$ 的区域对 $*p*, *q*$，$*f*(*p*, *q*)$ 的平均值是多少？你能回答他的问题吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$；$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$）。接下来 $*m*$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$；$*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}$），表示连接区域 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$ 的道路。

所有道路都是双向的，任意一对区域之间至多有一条道路。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数——![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/711ce638ce395f1d97748fe15c3c19ca75608d12.png) 的值。

如果答案的相对误差或绝对误差不超过 $10^{ - 4}$，则认为答案正确。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。一共有 $12$ 种可能的情况：

- $*p* = 1, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$。
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$。
- $*p* = 4, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 30$。
- $*p* = 1, *q* = 2, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$。
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 4, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$。
- $*p* = 4, *q* = 1, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$。

另外 $6$ 种情况与上述情况对称。平均值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d9c496a5e88de440a3524fc0ff31a1eb3c1319f.png)。

考虑第二个样例。一共有 $6$ 种可能的情况：

- $*p* = 1, *q* = 2, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$。
- $*p* = 2, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 20$。
- $*p* = 1, *q* = 3, *f*(*p*, *q*) = 10$。

另外 $3$ 种情况与上述情况对称。平均值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fb2ccbdfc02919359d0cc1f9a87c77b936f33464.png)。
